mapper.select: select ta.template_action_id, ta.template_point_id, ta.point_id, ta.action_id, ta.action_code, ta.action_name, ta.action_type, ta.sequence, ta.action_params, ta.remark from biz_task_template_point_action ta where ta.del_flag = '0' and ta.template_id = #{templateId} order by ta.template_point_id asc, ta.sequence asc, ta.template_action_id asc
